name: GeoDan Tools
description: Debug tools for GeoDan: hitboxes, hitbox trail and trajectory. Diagnostic only; never changes collision or physics. Switch them on from the TOOLS button on the pause menu.

hitboxes.name: Hitboxes
hitboxes.description: Outline each object's own hitbox in gameplay.

unclassified.name: Unclassified
unclassified.description: Also outline objects GeoDan cannot classify, in magenta.

hitbox-trail.name: Hitbox trail
hitbox-trail.description: Faded grey trail of the player's recent hitboxes.

trajectory.name: Trajectory
trajectory.description: Predicts hold and release using hidden player copies; stops at unsupported interactions.

portrait-preview-test.name: Portrait capture preview (TEST)
portrait-preview-test.description: Temporary diagnostic: continuously renders the gameplay object layer into a 360x1080 black portrait target and previews it on-screen. No frames are saved. Disable after testing; may reduce performance.
